parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description: The ID of the GTM instance that you want to query.

parameters.name: Lang
parameters.description: The language used by the user.

parameters.name: PageNumber
parameters.description: The number of the page to return. Pages start from page **1**. Default value: **1**.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries to return per page. Maximum value: **100**. Default value: **20**.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun alidns describe-gtm-instance-address-pools --lang en --instance-id gtmtest --page-number 1 --page-size 20 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun alidns DescribeGtmInstanceAddressPools --region cn-hangzhou --PageSize 20 --InstanceId gtmtest --PageNumber 1 --Lang en
